gemini_38_tts_cache_removal_extension.evidence: Model pages say Caching: Not supported since their 2026-10-09 update; Wayback shows the pricing page listed TTS cache rates at 20261008T175440Z and not at 20261009T223330Z.

model_added_backfill_extension.evidence: Backfill of model_added events for token-priced models that releases added while daily_pricing_release.py ran the event generator only for price changes (fixed 2026-10-29). Each event is generated from the snapshot pair of the release that added the model.

kimi_k2_lifecycle_extension.evidence: Kimi K2.6 and K2.7 Code turned deprecated in snapshot 2026-10-26 without an event, because their prices were last verified on 2026-10-09 and a lifecycle_update needs verified_at no earlier than detected_at. Release 2026-10-29-2 re-verified both against platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing (chat and batch tables, reports/price-evidence 20261029T063710Z and 20261029T063721Z), then generated the events from the last active snapshot to that release. Kimi publishes no deprecation or retirement date, so effective_from stays null.

mistral_large_4_list_cut_extension.evidence: The official Mistral Large 4 model page (docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-large-4-0, reports/price-evidence 20261031T051251Z) lists $0.7 input, $0.07 cached input and $2.1 output per 1M tokens with no promotion label, replacing the $1.36 / $0.14 / $4.18 list price verified 2026-10-21. Mistral published no announcement or effective date, so the event uses date_basis first_observed and effective_from stays null.

grok_imagine_quality_retirement_extensio.evidence: xAI's migration guide (docs.x.ai/developers/migration/imagine-image-quality-nov-2, reports/price-evidence 20261102T065821Z) retires grok-imagine-image-quality on 2026-11-02 after a 60-day notice from 2026-09-02; the slug keeps resolving to grok-imagine-image-2.0 at quality=low and bills at that rate. The canonical lifecycle already held these dates, so release 2026-11-02 only flips status deprecated -> retired and re-verifies the model, which produces this lifecycle_update. Released together with Claude Opus 4.8 / Opus 5 Fast-mode records, which add a processing mode and produce no event.

gemini_25_shutdown_redirect_extension.evidence: Google's deprecations and pricing pages (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations and /pricing, reports/price-evidence 20261103T042838Z and 20261103T042850Z, section extracts in .release-logs/g25-lifecycle-20261103) mark gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash deprecated, limit API access to existing users, and state that from December 1, 2026 all API requests route to gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite respectively, billed at the target's rates. Release 2026-11-03 sets status deprecated, retirement_date 2026-12-01 with a retirement_redirect transition, adds the deprecations page as a source and re-verifies both models (all recorded prices unchanged), which produces these two lifecycle_update events. Google publishes no deprecation announcement date, so deprecation_date is left unset.

p3_providers_model_added_extension.evidence: Release 2026-11-04-2 adds three first-party providers and their current models: Perplexity Sonar (Agent API models page, reports/price-evidence/perplexity/sonar/20261104T064309Z), Amazon Nova 2 Lite, Nova Pro, Nova Lite and Nova Micro (AWS Price List AmazonBedrock offer for us-east-1, publicationDate 2026-11-02T16:50:15Z, reports/price-evidence/amazon-nova/*/20261104T0641*Z), and Z.ai GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash, GLM-5.3-FlashX, GLM-5.2, GLM-5 and GLM-4.7 (docs.z.ai pricing page, reports/price-evidence/zhipu-ai/*/20261104T0643*Z). The generator emits one model_added event per new model with null old prices.

scheduled_price_change_backfill_extensio.rationale: New change_type scheduled_price_change, backfilled by scripts/backfill_scheduled_price_change_events.py from the snapshot pair in which each verified future price record first appeared: Gemini 4 Argon (2026-10-14, doubles 2026-12-01), Gemini 3.8 Flash (2026-10-09) and Gemini 3.6 Flash (2026-10-27), both doubling 2027-01-01. Announcements of future prices, not applied price changes.

reverify_2026_11_05_extension.note: Timestamp-only re-verification of models that earlier extensions approve; prices unchanged.

gpt_6_rosalind_model_added_extension.rationale: Release 2026-11-06-3 adds openai/gpt-6-rosalind (released 2026-10-30 per the OpenAI API changelog, restricted to the Rosalind Research trusted-access program); the generator appends one model_added event dated from the changelog.
